facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts

Workflow: build media list (database query by beat/genre/outlet) -> draft pitch + press release -> send personalized pitches -> follow-up cadence -> log responses in pitch tracker -> monitor coverage -> compile monthly report
Core labor sold by retainers: strategy, media-list building, pitching, follow-ups, reporting
Muck Rack's pitch tracking + AI list building automate the plumbing; the pitch itself and the relationship are human
Rebuildable: pitching via any email client with a tracking spreadsheet; the paid databases buy speed and completeness, not capability
